facts.claim_en: The U.S. Department of Labor's state table lists a state overtime (premium pay) rule for Alaska that starts after 8 hours in a day and 40 hours in a week.
facts.claim_es: La tabla estatal del Departamento de Trabajo de EE. UU. indica que Alaska tiene una regla estatal de horas extra (pago adicional) que empieza después de 8 horas en un día y 40 horas en una semana.
facts.source_name: U.S. Department of Labor, State Minimum Wage Laws
facts.quote: Basic Minimum Rate (per hour): $14.00 Premium Pay After Designated Hours 1 : Daily - 8, Weekly - 40

facts.claim_en: The same table says that under a voluntary flexible-hours plan approved by the Alaska Department of Labor, a 10-hour day and 40-hour week may be used, with premium pay after 10 hours a day.
facts.claim_es: La misma tabla indica que, con un plan voluntario de horario flexible aprobado por el Departamento de Trabajo de Alaska, se puede usar una jornada de 10 horas y una semana de 40, con pago adicional después de 10 horas al día.
facts.source_name: U.S. Department of Labor, State Minimum Wage Laws
facts.quote: Under a voluntary flexible work hour plan approved by the Alaska Department of Labor, a 10 hour day, 40 hour workweek may be instituted with premium pay after 10 hours a day.

facts.claim_en: The same table says Alaska's daily and weekly overtime requirement does not apply to employers with fewer than 4 employees.
facts.claim_es: La misma tabla indica que la regla de horas extra diaria y semanal de Alaska no se aplica a empleadores con menos de 4 empleados.
facts.source_name: U.S. Department of Labor, State Minimum Wage Laws
facts.quote: The premium overtime pay requirement on either a daily or weekly basis is not applicable to employers of fewer than 4 employees.

facts.claim_en: The U.S. Department of Labor says that under the federal Fair Labor Standards Act, covered employees who are not exempt must get overtime pay for hours over 40 in a workweek at no less than time and one-half their regular rate.
facts.claim_es: El Departamento de Trabajo de EE. UU. indica que, bajo la ley federal de normas laborales justas (FLSA), los empleados cubiertos y no exentos deben recibir pago de horas extra por las horas de más de 40 en una semana laboral, a no menos de una vez y media su tarifa regular.
facts.source_name: U.S. Department of Labor, Overtime Pay
facts.quote: Unless exempt, employees covered by the Act must receive overtime pay for hours worked over 40 in a workweek at a rate not less than time and one-half their regular rates of pay.

facts.claim_en: The U.S. Department of Labor says the federal law applies on a workweek basis and that averaging hours over two or more weeks is not permitted.
facts.claim_es: El Departamento de Trabajo de EE. UU. indica que la ley federal se aplica por semana laboral y que no se permite promediar las horas de dos o más semanas.
facts.source_name: U.S. Department of Labor, Overtime Pay
facts.quote: Averaging of hours over two or more weeks is not permitted.
